brief: A utensil holder with two bins that is waterproof and dishwasher safe.

requirements.evidence: Two adjacent cells (piece:0,0,0;full + piece:1,0,0;full) each with a full-depth bin (bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full, bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full) providing two open compartments for utensils. Caps and joint bolt applied.

Configurator checks fit/collisions only. Parts are 3D-printed plastic in user-chosen material; it cannot verify waterproofing, sealing or material resistance. Shape provides tray-like compartments but guarantees no waterproof performance.
Configurator does not model material, heat resistance, food safety or dishwasher compatibility. 3D-printed plastic parts have no verified dishwasher rating; must not be assumed safe for dishwashers.

finish.summary: Built 2-cell holder with two full-depth bins showing utensil-holder form. Waterproof and dishwasher-safe claims cannot be met by 3D-printed Hex Cluster parts - configurator verifies geometry only, not material performance.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
